tiles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production colored block sprite for a premium mobile match-3 puzzle. Input screenshot role: reference for the SIMPLE THIN BEVELS, BRIGHT SATURATED GAME RED and COMPACT PROPORTIONS of the small RED rectangular tiles visible on the board, NOT an image to edit or crop. Produce a NEW original tile in COLOR. Shape: a compact upright nearly-square rectangle, WIDTH about 91% of HEIGHT, with LONG straight side edges and corners only slightly rounded at about 6 percent radius. Simple broad smooth front face. Physical thickness is SHALLOW: very thin softly rounded bevel about 3 percent, a narrow slightly darker bottom edge, modest colored lighting along upper-left edge. Very subtle soft JELLY material, only gently bulging smooth colored face and a little translucent jelly depth at the edges. The appearance must be simple and clean at 30 pixels. The entire broad front should be bright, SATURATED, and pleasantly luminous in its own hue, NOT dark or heavy. Color specification: vivid bright RED with rich scarlet midtones, near #EE2A24, a gently darker red lower edge; never maroon, dark crimson, pink or washed out. Gentle controlled upper-left COLORED sheen, tiny mild reflection only, no big white patch or long bright white stripe. Absolutely NO inner inset, no recessed central panel, no embossed inner border, no double rim, no thick frame, no glowing contour all around, no oversized inflated pillow. It must look like a game piece, not a square UI button. No symbol, emblem, letter, fruit, jewel facet, crown, shield, pattern, text, number, watermark or other object. ONE isolated block on genuine alpha transparency, fully opaque colored body with jelly appearance painted internally. No glow, shadow, texture, specks or floor outside the solid silhouette. Center complete tile with generous transparent margin, same geometry and lighting across every color. Avoid dark saturated gradients that swallow the front. Plain silhouette and bright color separation are the priority.
